"""Bounded independent contracts: no inference, Docker, or downloads."""
import asyncio,inspect,json,sys,tempfile,threading
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.core.time import Timestamp,Duration
from devtools.models.interaction import (
    ConversationRef,InteractionSource,ModelRequest,ModelResponse,ModelSettings,
    ModelToolCall,ModelToolDefinition,Prompt,ProviderRequestSettings,
)
from devtools.models.interaction.providers import llama_cpp as client
from devtools.models.serving import llama_cpp as llama,vllm,huggingface as hf
from devtools.resources.commands import CommandExecutor,CommandResult

OUT=Path(__file__).parent;ROWS=[]
async def check(name,expected,action,kind='CONTROL',literal=None):
    try:
        value=action();observed=await value if inspect.isawaitable(value) else value
    except BaseException as error:
        observed={'harness_error':type(error).__name__,'message':str(error)}
    ROWS.append(dict(name=name,kind=kind,literal=literal,expected=expected,observed=observed,agrees=observed==expected))

class Writer:
    def __init__(self):self.data=b'';self.closed=False;self.waited=0
    def write(self,data):self.data+=data
    async def drain(self):pass
    def close(self):self.closed=True
    async def wait_closed(self):self.waited+=1

def wire(body,status=200):
    body=body if isinstance(body,bytes) else json.dumps(body).encode()
    return f'HTTP/1.1 {status} Test\r\nContent-Length: {len(body)}\r\n\r\n'.encode()+body
VALID={'id':'reply-1','model':'fixture','choices':[{'finish_reason':'stop','message':{'role':'assistant','content':'reply'}}],'usage':{'prompt_tokens':8,'completion_tokens':4,'total_tokens':99}}

async def send(body=VALID,status=200,request=None,observer_mode=None,backward=False,fail=None,facts=False):
    writer=Writer();connections=0;seen=[]
    async def connection(host,port):
        nonlocal connections
        connections+=1
        if fail=='connect':raise OSError('offline before write')
        reader=asyncio.StreamReader();reader.feed_data(wire(body,status));reader.feed_eof()
        if fail=='after-write':
            async def failed(*args,**kwargs):raise OSError('read failed after drain')
            reader.readuntil=failed
        return reader,writer
    class Observer:
        def interaction_completed(self,observation):
            seen.append(observation)
            if observer_mode=='raise':raise RuntimeError('observer-failed-after-response')
    times=[Timestamp.from_isoformat('2026-10-26T10:00:01+00:00'),Timestamp.from_isoformat('2026-10-26T10:00:00+00:00' if backward else '2026-10-26T10:00:02+00:00')]
    class Clock:
        @staticmethod
        def now():return times.pop(0)
    result=None;error=None
    with patch.object(asyncio,'open_connection',connection),patch.object(client,'Timestamp',Clock):
        interaction=client.LlamaCppInteraction(endpoint='http://fixture:8080',model='fixture',source=InteractionSource('fixture'),observer=Observer() if observer_mode else None)
        try:result=await interaction.send(request or ModelRequest(Prompt('question','user')))
        except BaseException as exc:error=type(exc).__name__
    if facts:
        observation=seen[0]
        return dict(caller_outcome=error,connections=connections,observations=len(seen),provider_response_id=observation.provider_response_id,provider_model=observation.provider_model,source=str(observation.source),response_source=str(observation.response.source),usage=[observation.response.usage.input_tokens,observation.response.usage.output_tokens,observation.response.usage.total_tokens])
    return dict(outcome=error or 'ModelResponse',content=result.content if result else None,connections=connections,wrote=bool(writer.data),closed=writer.closed,observations=len(seen),observed_reply=seen[0].response.content if seen else None,usage=[result.usage.input_tokens,result.usage.output_tokens,result.usage.total_tokens] if result and result.usage else None)

def expected_send(outcome='ModelResponse',content='reply',connections=1,wrote=True,closed=True,observations=0,observed_reply=None,usage=(8,4,99)):
    return dict(outcome=outcome,content=content,connections=connections,wrote=wrote,closed=closed,observations=observations,observed_reply=observed_reply,usage=list(usage) if usage else None)

class Executor(CommandExecutor):
    def __init__(self,mode='owned'):self.commands=[];self.mode=mode
    async def execute(self,command):
        self.commands.append(command)
        return CommandResult(command,0,b'true|true\n' if self.mode=='owned' else b'true|false\n',b'',Duration.seconds(0))

def serving(root,provider,*,port=8765,image='registry.example/server:cuda',executor=None):
    if provider=='llama':
        path=root/'fixture.gguf';path.write_bytes(b'GGUF')
        config=llama.LlamaCppServingConfig(llama.GGUFModel(resolve_path(path)),image,port,'wanted',4096,'all')
        return llama.LlamaCppServer(config=config,container_id='a'*64,container_name='fixture',executor=executor or Executor(),started_at=Timestamp.now())
    config=vllm.VLLMServingConfig(hf.HuggingFaceModelRef('org/model','a'*40),image,resolve_path(root/'cache'),port,'wanted',4096,.8,1)
    return vllm.VLLMServer(config=config,container_id='b'*64,container_name='fixture',executor=executor or Executor(),started_at=Timestamp.now())

class Fragments:
    def __init__(self,parts):self.parts=list(parts)
    async def read(self,n=-1):
        if n<0:result=b''.join(self.parts);self.parts=[];return result
        return self.parts.pop(0) if self.parts else b''

async def readiness(root,body='{"data":[{"id":"wanted"}]}',fragmented=False):
    health=wire(b'{}');models=wire(body.encode());head,sep,payload=models.partition(b'\r\n\r\n')
    readers=[Fragments([health]),Fragments([head+sep,payload] if fragmented else [models])];writers=[];error=None;result=None
    async def connection(host,port):
        writer=Writer();writers.append(writer);return readers[len(writers)-1],writer
    with patch.object(asyncio,'open_connection',connection):
        try:result=await serving(root,'vllm').status()
        except BaseException as exc:error=type(exc).__name__
    return dict(error=error,running=result.container_running if result else None,ready=result.model_ready if result else None,connections=len(writers),closed=all(w.closed for w in writers))

async def cleanup(root,provider,mode):
    writer=Writer();entered=asyncio.Event()
    class Reader:
        async def read(self,*args):
            entered.set()
            if mode=='oserror':raise OSError('failed response read')
            await asyncio.Event().wait()
    async def connection(*args):return Reader(),writer
    result=None;outcome=None
    with patch.object(asyncio,'open_connection',connection):
        server=serving(root,provider)
        task=asyncio.create_task(server.wait_ready(readiness_timeout=Duration.seconds(.02)) if mode=='timeout' else server.status())
        await entered.wait()
        if mode=='cancel':task.cancel()
        try:result=await task
        except BaseException as exc:outcome=type(exc).__name__
    return dict(outcome=outcome or 'ServerStatus',closed=writer.closed,waited=writer.waited,wrote=bool(writer.data),ready=result.model_ready if result else None)

async def real_cancel(root):
    """Authored empty local HTTP sink, not a model endpoint or serving process."""
    started=asyncio.Event();finished=asyncio.Event();client_writers=[];handler_errors=[]
    original=asyncio.open_connection
    async def handler(reader,writer):
        try:
            await reader.readuntil(b'\r\n\r\n');started.set();await reader.read()
        except Exception as exc:handler_errors.append(type(exc).__name__)
        finally:writer.close();await writer.wait_closed();finished.set()
    listener=await asyncio.start_server(handler,'127.0.0.1',0)
    port=listener.sockets[0].getsockname()[1]
    async def connection(*args):
        reader,writer=await original(*args);client_writers.append(writer);return reader,writer
    error=None
    try:
        with patch.object(asyncio,'open_connection',connection):
            task=asyncio.create_task(serving(root,'llama',port=port).status())
            await asyncio.wait_for(started.wait(),2);task.cancel()
            try:await task
            except asyncio.CancelledError as exc:error=exc
        observed=dict(outcome=type(error).__name__,closing=client_writers[0].is_closing(),request_received=started.is_set())
    finally:
        for writer in client_writers:writer.close();await writer.wait_closed()
        await asyncio.wait_for(finished.wait(),2)
        listener.close();await listener.wait_closed()
    assert not handler_errors,handler_errors
    return observed

async def invocation_cancel(mode):
    writer=Writer();entered=asyncio.Event()
    class Reader:
        async def readuntil(self,*args):entered.set();await asyncio.Event().wait()
    async def connection(*args):return Reader(),writer
    interaction=client.LlamaCppInteraction(endpoint='http://fixture:8080',model='fixture',source=InteractionSource('fixture'))
    async def run():
        if mode=='timeout':
            async with asyncio.timeout(.02):return await interaction.send(ModelRequest(Prompt('question','user')))
        return await interaction.send(ModelRequest(Prompt('question','user')))
    with patch.object(asyncio,'open_connection',connection):
        task=asyncio.create_task(run());await entered.wait()
        if mode=='cancel':task.cancel()
        try:await task
        except BaseException as exc:outcome=type(exc).__name__
    return dict(outcome=outcome,closed=writer.closed,waited=writer.waited,wrote=bool(writer.data))

async def cancelled_acquisition(root):
    entered=asyncio.Event();release=threading.Event();finished=threading.Event();loop=asyncio.get_running_loop()
    artifact=root/'cache'/'snapshots'/('a'*40)/'fixture.gguf'
    def download(**kwargs):
        loop.call_soon_threadsafe(entered.set);release.wait(2)
        artifact.parent.mkdir(parents=True);artifact.write_bytes(b'GGUF');finished.set();return str(artifact)
    with patch.object(hf,'hf_hub_download',download):
        task=asyncio.create_task(hf.acquire_huggingface_gguf(model=hf.HuggingFaceGGUFRef('org/model','a'*40,'fixture.gguf'),cache_root=resolve_path(root/'cache')))
        try:
            await entered.wait();task.cancel()
            try:await task
            except asyncio.CancelledError:cancelled=True
        finally:release.set()
        assert await asyncio.to_thread(finished.wait,2),'Authored thread fixture did not settle'
    return dict(cancelled=cancelled,artifact_exists=artifact.is_file(),bytes=artifact.read_bytes().decode())

def image_case(root,provider,image):
    try:server=serving(root,provider,image=image)
    except ValueError:return 'ValueError'
    return 'ACCEPTED'

async def schema_case():
    writer=Writer();connections=0
    async def connection(host,port):
        nonlocal connections
        connections+=1;reader=asyncio.StreamReader();reader.feed_data(wire(VALID));reader.feed_eof();return reader,writer
    try:definition=ModelToolDefinition('read','Read','{"type":"object","default":NaN}')
    except ValueError:return dict(outcome='ValueError',requests=0,strict_wire=None)
    with patch.object(asyncio,'open_connection',connection):
        result=await client.LlamaCppInteraction(endpoint='http://fixture',model='fixture',source=InteractionSource('fixture')).send(ModelRequest(Prompt('question','user'),tools=(definition,)))
    def refuse(value):raise ValueError('nonstandard constant '+value)
    try:json.loads(writer.data.partition(b'\r\n\r\n')[2],parse_constant=refuse);strict=True
    except ValueError:strict=False
    return dict(outcome=type(result).__name__,requests=connections,strict_wire=strict)

async def runtime_observer(mode):
    from devtools.agents.conversation import Conversation,ConversationMessage,ConversationMessageRole
    from devtools.execution import Runtime
    entered=0;finished=[];observed=[]
    async def post(endpoint,payload):
        nonlocal entered
        entered+=1;return VALID
    class ProviderObserver:
        def interaction_completed(self,value):
            observed.append(value)
            if mode=='provider':raise RuntimeError('provider observer after response')
    class AttemptObserver:
        def attempt_started(self,value):pass
        def attempt_finished(self,attempt,outcome):
            finished.append((attempt.state.value,getattr(getattr(outcome,'stage',None),'value',None)))
            if mode=='runtime':raise RuntimeError('attempt observer after response')
    conversation=Conversation.new();result=None;error=None
    with patch.object(client,'_post_chat_completion',post):
        interaction=client.LlamaCppInteraction(endpoint='http://fixture',model='fixture',source=InteractionSource('fixture'),observer=ProviderObserver())
        try:
            result=await Runtime(observer=AttemptObserver()).send(conversation=conversation,interaction=interaction,message=ConversationMessage.new('question',role=ConversationMessageRole.USER,source=InteractionSource('caller')))
        except BaseException as exc:error=type(exc).__name__
    return dict(outcome=error or 'ModelResponse',entered=entered,observed_reply=observed[0].response.content,history=[m.content for m in conversation.history],attempt_state=finished[0][0],attempt_stage=finished[0][1])

async def launch_lost_ack(root,provider):
    marker=root/(provider+'-executor-entry.txt');calls=[]
    class LostAck(Executor):
        async def execute(self,command):
            calls.append(command.arguments[0]);marker.write_bytes(b'entered before lost acknowledgment')
            raise ConnectionResetError('executor acknowledgment unavailable')
    configured=serving(root,provider,executor=LostAck())
    try:await type(configured).start(config=configured.config,executor=configured._executor)
    except ConnectionResetError:outcome='ConnectionResetError'
    return dict(outcome=outcome,executor_calls=calls,entered_marker=marker.exists(),returned_handle=False)

async def main():
    loop_errors=[]
    asyncio.get_running_loop().set_exception_handler(lambda loop,context:loop_errors.append(str(context)))
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-model-audit-') as temp:
        root=Path(temp)
        await check('normal-reported-total-not-derived',expected_send(),send)
        await check('observed-success',expected_send(observations=1,observed_reply='reply'),lambda:send(observer_mode='collect'))
        await check('foreign-provider-settings-pre-entry',expected_send('ValueError',None,connections=0,wrote=False,closed=False,usage=None),lambda:send(request=ModelRequest(Prompt('q','user'),provider_settings=ProviderRequestSettings('other'))))
        await check('continuation-pre-entry',expected_send('ValueError',None,connections=0,wrote=False,closed=False,usage=None),lambda:send(request=ModelRequest(Prompt('q','user'),conversation=ConversationRef(InteractionSource('fixture'),'opaque'))))
        await check('connection-failure',expected_send('LlamaCppTransportError',None,wrote=False,closed=False,usage=None),lambda:send(fail='connect'))
        await check('post-write-failure-no-retry',expected_send('LlamaCppTransportError',None,usage=None),lambda:send(fail='after-write'))
        await check('malformed-successful-root',expected_send('LlamaCppResponseError',None,usage=None),lambda:send(body=[]))
        await check('malformed-reported-usage',expected_send('LlamaCppResponseError',None,usage=None),lambda:send(body={**VALID,'usage':{'total_tokens':True}}))
        await check('missing-usage-not-zero',expected_send(usage=None),lambda:send(body={k:v for k,v in VALID.items() if k!='usage'}))
        await check('observer-failure-after-success',expected_send('RuntimeError',None,observations=1,observed_reply='reply',usage=None),lambda:send(observer_mode='raise'),'EXISTING_ADR0001_B0011_LIMITATION')
        await check('observer-failure-still-has-response-facts',dict(caller_outcome='RuntimeError',connections=1,observations=1,provider_response_id='reply-1',provider_model='fixture',source='fixture',response_source='fixture',usage=[8,4,99]),lambda:send(observer_mode='raise',facts=True),'EXISTING_ADR0001_B0011_LIMITATION')
        await check('backward-clock-observed',expected_send('ValueError',None,usage=None),lambda:send(observer_mode='collect',backward=True),'EXISTING_ADR0001_B0011_LIMITATION')
        await check('backward-clock-unobserved',expected_send(),lambda:send(backward=True))
        await check('runtime-provider-observer-failure',dict(outcome='RuntimeError',entered=1,observed_reply='reply',history=['question'],attempt_state='failed',attempt_stage='interaction_invocation'),lambda:runtime_observer('provider'),'EXISTING_ADR0001_B0011_LIMITATION')
        await check('runtime-terminal-observer-contained',dict(outcome='ModelResponse',entered=1,observed_reply='reply',history=['question','reply'],attempt_state='succeeded',attempt_stage=None),lambda:runtime_observer('runtime'),'EXISTING_ADR0001_B0011_LIMITATION')
        for status,error in [(200,'LlamaCppResponseError'),(500,'LlamaCppHttpError')]:
            await check('invalid-response-utf8-'+str(status),expected_send(error,None,usage=None),lambda status=status:send(body=b'\xff',status=status),'NEW_UTF8_ERROR_NORMALIZATION','Raw body ff after well-framed HTTP '+str(status))
        for mode,outcome in [('cancel','CancelledError'),('timeout','TimeoutError')]:
            await check('invocation-'+mode,dict(outcome=outcome,closed=True,waited=1,wrote=True),lambda mode=mode:invocation_cancel(mode))
        await check('readiness-complete-control',dict(error=None,running=True,ready=True,connections=2,closed=True),lambda:readiness(root))
        await check('readiness-split-body',dict(error=None,running=True,ready=True,connections=2,closed=True),lambda:readiness(root,fragmented=True),'NEW_VLLM_READINESS_RESPONSE','Matching model response delivered as header then body; each valid read(n) may be short.')
        for body in ['[]','null']:
            await check('readiness-nonobject-'+body,dict(error=None,running=True,ready=False,connections=2,closed=True),lambda body=body:readiness(root,body=body),'NEW_VLLM_READINESS_RESPONSE',body)
        await check('readiness-wrong-model-control',dict(error=None,running=True,ready=False,connections=2,closed=True),lambda:readiness(root,body='{"data":[{"id":"other"}]}'))
        for provider in ['llama','vllm']:
            await check('launch-lost-ack-'+provider,dict(outcome='ConnectionResetError',executor_calls=['run'],entered_marker=True,returned_handle=False),lambda provider=provider:launch_lost_ack(root,provider),'SUPPORTED_UNCERTAIN_EFFECT_LIMITATION','Actual temporary marker written by deterministic executor before raising; no Docker/container effect claimed.')
            for mode,outcome,ready in [('oserror','ServerStatus',False),('cancel','CancelledError',None),('timeout','ServingReadinessTimeoutError',None)]:
                await check('readiness-owned-close-'+provider+'-'+mode,dict(outcome=outcome,closed=True,waited=1,wrote=True,ready=ready),lambda provider=provider,mode=mode:cleanup(root,provider,mode),'NEW_READINESS_WRITER_CLEANUP')
            await check('image-registry-port-'+provider,'ValueError',lambda provider=provider:image_case(root,provider,'registry.example:5000/team/server'),'NEW_IMAGE_TAG_ADMISSION','A registry authority port is not an image tag after its final slash. No Docker entry.')
            for image in ['registry.example:5000/team/server:cuda','registry.example:5000/team/server@sha256:'+'a'*64]:
                await check('image-explicit-control-'+provider+'-'+str(len(image)),'ACCEPTED',lambda provider=provider,image=image:image_case(root,provider,image))
        await check('real-readiness-cancel-writer',dict(outcome='CancelledError',closing=True,request_received=True),lambda:real_cancel(root),'NEW_READINESS_WRITER_CLEANUP','Authored local HTTP sink; real StreamWriter inspected before fixture cleanup, not a model-serving process.')
        await check('cancelled-acquisition-not-rollback',dict(cancelled=True,artifact_exists=True,bytes='GGUF'),lambda:cancelled_acquisition(root),'SUPPORTED_UNCERTAIN_EFFECT_LIMITATION')
        await check('tool-schema-nonstandard-json',dict(outcome='ValueError',requests=0,strict_wire=None),schema_case,'NEW_TOOL_JSON_SYNTAX','{"type":"object","default":NaN}')
        for literal in ['NaN','Infinity','-Infinity']:
            body={'choices':[{'message':{'role':'assistant','content':'','tool_calls':[{'type':'function','id':'call-1','function':{'name':'read','arguments':'{"value":'+literal+'}'}}]},'finish_reason':'tool_calls'}]}
            await check('tool-argument-nonstandard-'+literal,expected_send('LlamaCppResponseError',None,usage=None),lambda body=body:send(body=body),'NEW_TOOL_JSON_SYNTAX',literal)
    value=dict(at=str(Timestamp.now()),python=sys.version,rows=ROWS,unhandled_loop_errors=loop_errors,harness_errors=[r['name'] for r in ROWS if isinstance(r['observed'],dict) and 'harness_error' in r['observed']],unexpected_controls=[r['name'] for r in ROWS if not r['agrees'] and not r['kind'].startswith('NEW_')],scope='Only deterministic transport/Command/download doubles, temporary data and one authored local empty HTTP sink. No inference, Docker, model download, source edit or scientific replay.')
    (OUT/'probes.json').write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps(dict(cases=len(ROWS),unexpected_controls=value['unexpected_controls'],reproduced=[r['name'] for r in ROWS if not r['agrees']]),indent=2))
    assert not value['unexpected_controls'] and not value['harness_errors'] and not loop_errors,value
asyncio.run(main())
